steps.name: final-static-and-format
steps.command: git status --short --branch && git diff --check && cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/styles/pinned-media.css src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts && npm run lint
